reason: $24.99 for the first box is under a dollar a day, and the named lab report on the batch is more than most brands give me. I'd grab one box at the launch price and see if I actually stick with it.
objection: Foil sachets feel like extra packaging waste, and I forget my vitamins half the time, so I might not finish the 30 days. At $29.99 full price I'd wait for a coupon instead.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were not there and it was full price $29.99 with no coupon, I'd pass.
